instruction:
Expanded Two-Story Office From Init Model

This task starts from Desktop input file: /home/user/Desktop/init.osm. Reference image is provided on the Desktop: /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png. Modify the OpenStudio 3.10 model as needed and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json with size at least 10 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10.
3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 2 OS:BuildingStory objects, 10 OS:Space objects, and 10 OS:ThermalZone objects.
4. The OS:Space names are exactly C11-F1-North, C11-F1-South, C11-F1-West, C11-F1-East, C11-F1-Core, C11-F2-North, C11-F2-South, C11-F2-West, C11-F2-East, and C11-F2-Core.
5. Every OS:Space references an OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2.
6. The model has exactly 68 OS:Surface objects: 10 Floor surfaces, 10 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 48 Wall surfaces.
7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 5 Ground, 21 Outdoors, and 42 Surface.
8. The model has exactly 16 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 16.
9. The model contains exactly 10 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 10 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and 10 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects.
10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 30.00 m, Y span 18.00 m, and Z span 8.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
11. The sum of floor surface areas is 1080.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 768.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
13. The total fixed-window area is 268.80 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
14. /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json contains total_floor_area_m2, zone_count, and total_window_area_m2 values matching the evaluator-computed model metrics with tolerance max(0.10, 1%).

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
